title: From Spurious to Causal: Low-rank Orthogonal Subspace Intervention for Generalizable Face Forgery Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cross-dataset generalization on multiple face forgery benchmarks and assessing robustness against image perturbations (e.g., blur, noise, color saturation) to measure the model's reliance on forgery-irrelevant factors such as background style and specific facial identities.
